_about: Curated laptops tracked by the scraper. Specs are a baseline captured from retailer product pages; the scraper refreshes prices and availability. Edit 'families' for model-level notes and 'laptops' to add or remove configurations.

hp-victus-15.name: Victus 15
pros: Cheapest way into a real dedicated GPU
Two SO-DIMM slots for cheap RAM upgrades later
cons: RTX 4050/3050 are near the bottom of the stack

acer-nitro-v16.name: Nitro V 16
pros: Thunderbolt port, Ethernet and two M.2 slots
cons: Core 7 240H is a modest CPU for heavy work

alienware-15.name: Alienware 15 (15.3")
pros: Alienware build quality at an entry price
Expandable to 32GB with two SO-DIMM slots
cons: New model with few in-depth reviews so far

gigabyte-gaming-a16.name: Gaming A16
cons: Core i7-13620H is a 2023 H-series chip
Brightness and color are only average

gigabyte-aero-x16.name: Aero X16
pros: Thin (0.65") and light (4.2 lb) with a 2560x1600 165Hz screen
32GB RAM standard and a USB4 port
Strong battery life for work (Copilot+ Ryzen AI 7 350)
cons: GPU limited to 85W, so a 5070 here performs like a full-power 5060
8-core CPU trails HX chips in heavy rendering

lenovo-loq-essential-15.name: LOQ Essential 15 (Arc B390)
pros: No dedicated GPU means long battery life and low heat
Panther Lake CPU is fast and efficient for work
cons: Integrated Arc B390 is far behind any RTX card for gaming

asus-tuf-f16.name: TUF Gaming F16
pros: Rugged, serviceable chassis with two SO-DIMM slots
cons: Battery is small for a 16" machine

asus-tuf-a16.name: TUF Gaming A16
cons: Only 16GB RAM and 512GB SSD in this config
No OLED/high-res option at this price

msi-crosshair-a16-hx.name: Crosshair A16 HX
cons: RTX 5060 is the weak link for a 240Hz QHD panel

hp-omen-16.name: OMEN 16
cons: Pricier than TUF/LOQ for the same GPU
Retailer lists an odd 1.8" height (it's ~1" thick)

alienware-16x-aurora.name: 16X Aurora
cons: Hot air exhausts out the sides

hp-omen-transcend-14.name: OMEN Transcend 14
pros: Long battery life for a gaming laptop
Good for school or work by day
cons: Low GPU power limit, so it games well below thicker laptops

lenovo-loq-15.name: LOQ 15
cons: Best Buy's regular price is far above its usual sale price

lenovo-legion-5i-15.name: Legion 5i 15.3"
cons: Only 16GB RAM and 512GB in this config
Core 7 245HX is a refreshed older-gen chip

acer-predator-triton-14.name: Predator Triton 14 AI
pros: 3.5 lb with a 2880x1800 OLED touch screen
Lunar Lake CPU sips power on battery
cons: 8-core Lunar Lake CPU is weak for heavy multitasking or rendering

asus-rog-flow-z13.name: ROG Flow Z13
pros: A 2.65 lb tablet that games like an RTX 4060 laptop
16-core Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a workstation-class CPU
Unified memory: 32GB or 64GB shared with the GPU
cons: 13.4" screen and detachable keyboard aren't for long gaming sessions

acer-predator-neo-16.name: Predator Helios Neo 16S AI
pros: Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus is one of the fastest laptop CPUs
cons: RTX 5060 version is overpriced for its GPU

asus-zephyrus-g16-2025.name: ROG Zephyrus G16 (2025)
pros: Great all-rounder for work and travel
cons: GPU power capped around 120W, well below thick 175W laptops
High price for the GPU tier

asus-zephyrus-g16-2026.name: ROG Zephyrus G16 (2026)
pros: Panther Lake Core Ultra 9 386H: fast and efficient
cons: Very expensive: an RTX 5070 Ti costs $3,400+ here

lenovo-legion-pro-5i.name: Legion Pro 5i
cons: Some configs pair a slow price with an 8GB RTX 5070

lenovo-legion-pro-5-amd.name: Legion Pro 5 (AMD)
cons: Best Buy's own price is high for an RTX 5060 (marketplace sellers are cheaper)

asus-tuf-a14-max.name: TUF A14 (Ryzen AI Max+)
pros: 12-core Ryzen AI Max+ 392 is great for work
cons: Integrated GPU still trails a real RTX 5060

asus-rog-strix-g16.name: ROG Strix G16 (2025)
pros: Cheapest RTX 5070 Ti here with a 16-core CPU

asus-zephyrus-g14-2025.name: ROG Zephyrus G14 (2025)
pros: Great work-and-travel machine that still games
cons: Pricey; RTX 5060 config is weak value

asus-zephyrus-g14-2026.name: ROG Zephyrus G14 (2026)
pros: Panther Lake Core Ultra 9 386H + RTX 5070 Ti in 3.5 lb
cons: 16GB soldered RAM on the Best Buy config

msi-stealth-16.name: Stealth 16 AI / AI+
pros: Thin but still has SO-DIMM slots (up to 128GB)
cons: Price is high for the RTX 5060 config

lenovo-legion-7a-15.name: Legion 7a 15.3" (Ryzen AI Max+)
pros: Great battery life and quiet for work

hp-omen-max-16.name: OMEN MAX 16
cons: Battery life is short when gaming

asus-rog-strix-18-2026.name: ROG Strix 18 / SCAR 18 (2026)
cons: Very expensive at the top end

asus-rog-strix-scar-18-2025.name: ROG Strix SCAR 18 (2025)
cons: Mixed customer reviews (3.8/5 at Best Buy)

acer-predator-helios-18.name: Predator Helios 18 AI
cons: Slow DDR5-4400 on the RTX 5080 config

alienware-area-51.name: Area-51 (16"/18")
pros: Sturdy premium build with great cooling
cons: Very expensive for an RTX 5070 Ti

asus-zephyrus-duo.name: ROG Zephyrus Duo (dual-screen)
pros: Two 16" 2880x1800 OLED touch screens: amazing for work
cons: Niche: you pay a lot for the second screen

gigabyte-aorus-master-16.name: Aorus Master 16
cons: Weak Best Buy reviews (2/5, small sample)

lg-gram-pro-max-17.name: gram Pro Max 17
pros: Huge battery life claim (32.5 h video)
cons: RTX 5050 at low power: light gaming only

asus-v16.name: V16
pros: Light and quiet for a 16" laptop
cons: Best Buy's RTX 5050 price ($1,300) is poor value

razer-blade-16-2026.name: Blade 16 (2026)
pros: Full-power GPUs in a thin laptop, Thunderbolt 5
cons: Most expensive way to get each GPU tier

framework-16.name: Laptop 16
pros: Swap the GPU module, ports, keyboard and mainboard later
cons: Clear price premium over equivalent RTX 5070 laptops
Price depends on the configurator (tracked manually)
